arms.color_swap: Both candidate owners on each of 16 exact fresh roots versus unchanged Unit-board/Unit-hand, no-dynamic Unit-order foe.

changed_premise: The prior 5x5 leaf-only replication changed both board and hand values in its static arm. This panel isolates board values only: both arms and the fixed foe use Unit hand values, empty dynamic/spatial terms, Unit ordering, and identical search budgets. Fresh seeds and roots are used; no outcome pooling.

contrasts.unknowns: For every paired root/owner slot, independently bound each UNKNOWN arm reward to [-1,+1]; report all-slot bounds, finite-only means, owner/turn/seed strata, leave-one-seed-out envelope, action changes and costs.

cost.expected: Under four minutes: 64 physical games, half of a previously completed 128-game D3 single-process panel; hard cap 2400 seconds.
cost.cheaper_alternative: Replay-only feature inspection cannot measure finite-budget utility; 64 fresh balanced slots are the smallest existing eight-seed/two-root/two-owner design.

decision: Within this eight-seed finite sample, retain the board-only candidate only if all-slot reward lower bounds are strictly positive overall, for both owners and every leave-one-seed-out omission, and median paired candidate node cost is no more than 10% higher. Otherwise do not retain it in this scope; preserve UNKNOWN bounds. No population, cross-game price law, global default or strength claim.
integrity: No training, solver, auxiliary checkout, outcome pooling, or product/default changes.
Both candidate arms and fixed foe use identical Unit hand values; dynamic/spatial/compact terms are absent; candidate and foe ordering checkpoint is Unit.
Keep D3/8192-node/0.5-second/q0/TT0/root-window-off budgets identical; preserve all actual outcomes, UNKNOWNs, histories, promotions, drops, work counts and wall costs.
question: On eight unseen generated 5x5 rule seeds, does static_v2 board material alone improve finite-budget outcomes when hand values, dynamic evaluator terms, and candidate/foe move ordering are held to Unit?

roots.selection: Fresh roots generated only from the listed new rules and prefix-seed formula; candidate arm shares each exact root and color.

rules.selection: Eight new seeds checked against every existing research plan before freeze. Rebuild every rule/profile/root and replay every result; do not reuse rules or roots.
